purpose: Exact production controls plus explicitly proposed harmless preview behavior.
audit_basis: Direct callback inspection of retained 1.21 source; retained 1.19/1.20.1 preserve the same numeric slot layouts. Source references are to the 1.21 canonical audited worktree.
slot_numbering: Zero-based native top-container index. Each control acts only through native slots, not painted pixels.
preview_status: InventoryDebug implements immutable left-click teaching fixtures and original-action explanations. Representative routes and conditional controls have been independently reviewed against this map. Implemented scope is listed below; preview_proposal fields describe intended demonstrations and must not be read as a claim that every branch is simulated. No live Quasar interaction testing is claimed.

implemented_navigation: Auction pages, selected listing confirmation, captured origin/page return, owner-list and watchlist entry
Chest-shop buyer amount screen, owner settings, listing-editor Back, upgrade selection/deselection and representative apply return
Configured admin category to example listing page
Qualifying remote chest-shop advertisement to shop fixture
Local trade own-ready toggle, other-ready completion/close, money-editor return
Valid ticket confirm/close and cancel; invalid confirm absent
implemented_example_values: Notification and privacy flags, including private rank display
Listing enabled/buying/selling flags with conditional price arrows
Quantity and selected lot amount (fixture bound1..64)
Offered money (fixture bound0..1000), using actual left-click +/-10 step
explanatory_only: Actual purchase/sale/recovery effects, stock or balance mutation
Non-left original click variants, including right-click sale and shift-right ownership actions
Other catalog controls without an explicit modeled transition
preview_implementation.interaction_boundary: Only native PICKUP button0 dispatches preview actions. Right/shift/drag/swap/drop/clone/double-click and all real item movement are suppressed. Fresh sample stacks remain locked; the immutable model has no Quasar, inventory, economy, teleport or rank APIs.
preview_implementation.test_limit: Source review and automated fixture checks are not in-game rendering, real pack-response or production transaction tests.

artwork_rules: Preserve transparent liveSlots windows for icons, counts and hover feedback.
Use fixed action legends on permanently empty protected space; dynamic prices/counts/state remain native item/name/lore.
A bitmap border/label does not enlarge the native slot hitbox.
Conditional controls must not be represented as always-enabled solely by paint.
Configured admin pages, storage and dense listing grids retain all potential item windows.

controls.trigger: Any click reaching this callback; no explicit ClickType filter.
controls.real_effect: Toggle own ready. Local trade applies immediately if both become ready, otherwise reopens both views. Remote trade toggles ACTIVE/READY, sends update and refreshes.
controls.preview_proposal: idle -> self_ready; self_ready -> idle. other_ready click represents completing the trade: report simulated completion and close, rather than invent a durable confirm stage. A directly selected both_ready fixture toggles own readiness off -> other_ready; both_ready is not a promised long-lived production step.
native_lore: Both players must be Ready to complete the trade.
Click to toggle your ready status.

controls.label: Your Offered Money
controls.trigger: Any click reaching this callback; no explicit ClickType filter.
controls.real_effect: Open trade_money when balance>0; otherwise show no-money message and remain.
controls.preview_proposal: Open money fixture preserving offered amount; blocked no-money example stays.

controls.label: Money You Will Receive
controls.trigger: none
controls.real_effect: Display incoming money when >0.
controls.preview_proposal: Read-only example; no navigation or game mutation.

notes: No explicit Cancel or Close slot. Closing the trade menu invokes existing trade cancellation logic.
trade_both_ready can be brief/absent for local trade because the ready callback applies immediately.
Decorative separators and bottom filler are never new click targets.

controls.label: Increase offered money
controls.trigger: RIGHT 1; LEFT 10; SHIFT_RIGHT 100; SHIFT_LEFT 1000; other click types ignored.
controls.real_effect: Add selected step, clamp, then write proposed trade-bank money and reopen money screen (range0..balance).
controls.preview_proposal: Increase fixture value using actual click-step mapping, clamp, refresh.

controls.label: Decrease offered money
controls.trigger: RIGHT 1; LEFT 10; SHIFT_RIGHT 100; SHIFT_LEFT 1000; other click types ignored.
controls.real_effect: Subtract selected step, clamp, then write proposed trade-bank money and reopen money screen (range0..balance).
controls.preview_proposal: Decrease fixture value using actual click-step mapping, clamp, refresh.

controls.label: Offered Money: <amount>
controls.trigger: Any click reaching this callback; no explicit ClickType filter.
controls.real_effect: Confirm/return to trade. Local resets both ready states then reopens; remote opens with other-ready=false then sends update.
controls.preview_proposal: Return to trade_idle fixture with chosen offered amount; no money transfer.
native_lore: Use the buttons to change offered money.
Click to confirm and return to the trade screen.

notes: The real container is GENERIC_3x3 (dispenser), not a 9-column chest.
Themed title is art-only for stable centered positioning. Live amount/balance remain on emerald4.
No separate Back/Cancel item; center4 is confirm-and-return. Arrow clicks update trade-bank proposed money before return.
